SELECT tt.*, (SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'INVOICE_HANDOVER_STATUS' AND scv.value =tt.handover_status ) AS handover_status_n, (SELECT e.NAME FROM sys_user s, sys_user_allocation a, fnd_employee e, fnd_employee_assigns fa WHERE s.user_id = a.user_id AND a.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fa.EMPLOYEE_ID = e.EMPLOYEE_ID
and a.USER_ID=tt.handover_person) AS handover_person_n FROM invoice_handover_application tt
1=1
and tt.invoice_handover_id = #{invoiceHandoverId}
mapper.update: update invoice_handover_application a set a.handover_status = 'TRANSFERING' , a.handover_person = #{handoverPerson} where a.invoice_handover_id=#{invoiceHandoverId}
update invoice_handover_application a set a.handover_status = 'TRANSFER_END' ,a.review_person = #{reviewPerson} where a.invoice_handover_id=#{invoiceHandoverId}
